$comment: Maps for location sharing (ADR 0131, bipe-chat/bipe#768). Every map request goes to baseUrl, our tile server in Brazil; no other map service and no API key. staticPath is the tileserver-gl static map: the app replaces {style}, {lon}, {lat}, {zoom}, {width} and {height} (points; the server renders @2x). width and height stay at or under maxStaticSize. The server draws the attribution into each image. defaultZoom: a new pin and a received location without zoom_level. coordinateDecimals: digits after the point in the geo URI (6 is about 0.1 m). detailBounds (west, south, east, north) is the area the server has at every zoom, the same box as bipe-infra maps.yaml; outside it the server has the world only to zoom 6, so a map centred outside detailBounds goes no deeper than outsideMaxZoom. live (MSC3489 live location): durationsMinutes are the choices of the send screen (under 60 shown as minutes, else hours). The app sends a new position when the phone moved at least the chosen distance (distancesMetres, setting chats.liveLocation, default defaultDistanceMetres), at most every minIntervalSeconds, and while it moves at least every maxIntervalSeconds.
